advance-before-capture permanently destroyed result evidence twice; audition flags drive all later planning
planner objective/risk-gate separation: without futility surfacing the planner can silently waste a season (0906); decision-trace separation is its audit trail

should_fix_before_next_live.why: scene-skip week consumption is rare (1 occurrence) but irreversible; a run with operator attention can avoid SKIP on business frames
evidence-in-flush upgrades recovery quality; recovery itself works via backfill today

battle executor integration does not exist yet; F-07 cleanup (B6) must land before it does, but no live run touches battle Auto until then
